label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
**Sunbelt Charter Coaches — only 2 of 4 coaches showed for our 220-person client dinner**

I’m posting the facts from a client dinner last Thursday, Nov. 5, so other Vegas planners can make an informed call before CES season.

We booked four coaches for 220 people. Hotel pickup was 6:15 p.m., offsite at a ranch venue in Henderson. I had written confirmation twice, most recently Tuesday, Nov. 3. Total was $8,400: 50% deposit in September, balance seven days out. The dispatcher on all the paperwork was Corey.

Only two coaches showed. The first was 55 minutes late, and the driver said he got the job at 5 p.m. The second broke down on the 215. The AC was dead and people were stuck on the shoulder for about 40 minutes. I ended up putting 60 people in Ubers and Lyfts on my company card, roughly $1,900. Dinner started at 8:40 instead of 7, and the caterer charged us overtime.

One late bus I could forgive. No backup plan and no communication is not okay. The office line has gone to voicemail since Friday, and I still don’t have a refund.

I’m asking Sunbelt to refund the two coaches that never came plus the rideshare costs. They were great on two small airport runs last spring, which is why I trusted them with this. But I can’t recommend them for anything big until they fix dispatch. My client is now reviewing whether they keep us for their March event, and that’s on Sunbelt.

If you’re booking airport or offsite runs for a large group, get a backup plan in writing or use someone else.
